newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB ups 96/97 Australia wheat crop to 20 m/t.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB ups 96/97 Australia wheat crop to 20 m/t.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board said on Tuesday said it had revised its forecast for the 1996/97 (April/March) crop to 20 million tonnes from 19 million.

The revision, which was made last Friday and contained in the AWB's weekly grains report released on Tuesday, is due to a general increase in estimated yields in all states, the AWB said. The revised estimate brings the AWB more in line with estimates made by other forecasters.
Isolated storm and hail had caused some crop damage, although this had been outweighed by the benefits of good rains, the AWB said in its latest weekly grain market report.
If the AWB's new estimate is correct, it will mean the 1996/97 crop would be Australia's second largest on record behind the 1983/84 crop of 22 million tonnes.
Australian Wheat Forecasters Pty Ltd on Monday raised its 1996/97 forecast to 20.43 million tonnes from 19.80 million.
